description: Questions that land on the three planted contradictions, phrased several ways each, plus near-miss questions that must NOT be reported as conflicts.

conflict_questions.question: What is the minimum attendance I need to sit the end-semester exam?
How many classes can I miss and still be allowed to write the exam?
I have 70% attendance. Am I eligible to appear in the examination?
How much notice must I give before staying out of the hostel overnight?
I want to go home for the weekend. How far in advance do I apply for hostel leave?
What CGPA do I need to keep my merit scholarship next year?
My CGPA is 7.7. Do I lose my tuition fee remission?

near_miss_questions.question: How many working days do I have to submit a medical certificate after missing a mid-semester test?
near_miss_questions.note: AR-4.3 says seven days, AR-5.4 says ten, but they attach to different events and are consistent.

near_miss_questions.question: How much notice does the warden give before inspecting my room?
near_miss_questions.note: HH-2.4 states 24 hours for inspection. Same unit as HH-4.1 leave notice, different subject.

near_miss_questions.question: Do I need to clear my dues before getting an admit card?
near_miss_questions.note: AR-5.2 and FS-3.1 agree; a naive overlap detector may treat agreement as disagreement.
